# tier 3, group hardware, route worstgpu, version payload 1.3, role ab
# gpu25: at The Dump 446 of 585 live textures (20.2 of 29.4 MiB) have mip levels and 23.7 MiB are uncompressed LINEAR; the default swizzle (swz-d) skips every mip-mapped texture, so it cannot reach the stadium material. This turns the mip chains in too (the case that once drew a wrong HUD icon; swz20 notes). Run swz-d first; this one only if it is clean. Reads: [lane] gpu, every HUD icon, [texclass] outcomes; any wrong icon = stop.
